name: TRE Holdings Corporation
summary: TRE Holdings Corporation, operating through its various affiliated companies, specializes in comprehensive metal and automotive recycling services throughout Japan. The firm actively reclaims resources from a diverse range of materials, including household waste, home electronics, compact consumer devices, industrial byproducts, and landfill substances. Beyond recycling, its endeavors encompass the renewable energy industry, environmental engineering projects, and providing expert environmental consulting. The company also offers specialized services for industrial waste treatment. Founded in 2021, the corporation is based in Tokyo, Japan.
